## Summary

The [[stripe]] Terminal smart-reader overviews describe the Dashboard shop for available readers and accessories, JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native SDK compatibility, and communication with SDKs and the Stripe API over the internet. Both name BBPOS WisePOS E, Stripe Reader S700/S710 and Verifone readers for server-driven integration. The 2026-11-07 overview also names Stripe Reader T600.

The separate [[raw/stripe-terminal-readers-stripe-reader-t600-2026-11-07|2026-11-07 T600 product guide]], lines 11–15, describes an Android-based countertop and pole-mount reader. It documents internet, LAN and handoff connections with the SDK. Stripe recommends server-driven integration when the POS is on a separate device and offline card payment collection is unnecessary.

The 2026-05-01 overview listed ten S710 markets: US, CA, GB, IE, SG, AU, NZ, FR, BE, MY. The November overview adds BG, HR, CY, EE, HK, HU, LV, LI, LT, MX, MT, RO, SK and SI. The S700, WisePOS E and Verifone rows retain their May lists.

The [[raw/stripe-terminal-payments-setup-reader-stripe-reader-s700-s710-2026-11-07|2026-11-07 S700/S710 setup capture]] has 39 entries in its second badge (line 8), including AT, ES, SE, NO, PT and FI, which the same-day 24-market overview row omits. The captures leave the relationship between the lists, rollout and account-level availability unresolved.

## Software Updates and Restarts

- **Software updates.** Stripe sends automatic updates while a reader is idle and connected to power, at midnight in the assigned location’s time zone. An unplugged reader can begin updating when next powered on. Rebooting the reader manually checks for an update.
- **Daily restart.** The overviews describe a midnight PCI restart and morning disconnection from the POS app. The separate May [[source-stripe-terminal-reboot-time|reboot-window guide]] identifies midnight as the default and documents a configurable window in the registered location’s local time, with readers restarting at staggered times in that window.
